title: UserUpdatedPayload
description: Subset of iam-user-profile's UserUpdatedPayload consumed by this service on delegation-cascade-q (Bug 2/DLG-D26) to drive CascadeService.EndForDisabledDelegate when status=disabled. Only the fields this service actually reads are declared; additionalProperties:true allows the full user-profile payload to pass through. Mirrors internal/core/domain/event_payloads.go UserUpdatedPayload exactly.

user_id.description: The user whose profile was updated.

changed_fields.description: List of field names that changed. This service dispatches only when 'status' is present.

status.description: Populated only when 'status' is in changed_fields. This service dispatches only on 'disabled'.
